sources.title: OLMo 3 — Base / pretrained models — Open Source AI Map
sources.snippet: The weights ship with the 9.3-trillion-token Dolma 3 corpus, the training code, the data recipes and intermediate checkpoints, so the whole run can be inspected and modified. It supersedes OLMo 2. Verified 2026-08-13 via the Ai2 OLMo 3 blog, the Olmo-3-1025-7B model card and the allenai/OLMo repository.
